reason: At base REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4} but format() only implements YY/YYYY, so lone Y and YYY fall through to the timezone-offset fallback, producing something like +0000 instead of literal Y / 24Y.
After the fix REGEX_FORMAT only matches YYYY|YY, so Y stays literal and YYY renders as YY plus a literal Y, matching the expected output.
Base request.ts already decodes percent-encoded params via the %-check plus tryDecode; the PR is a behavior-preserving refactor, so decoding to a space still works.
The extracted tryDecodeURIComponent performs the same %-check and decode as the inline code it replaces, so percent-decoded route params still return the decoded character.
At base reschedule only does zincrby in Redis and never updates @score, so the in-memory entry still reports the stale pre-reschedule score and time.
The fix adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so entry.score and entry.at reflect the new reschedule time immediately.
The PR only changes parseRangesSpecifier (Range header whitespace); Content-Type parsing with charset=UTF-8 is untouched, so the test behaves as before.
Range-header whitespace trimming does not affect Content-Type charset parsing; text/plain with charset=UTF-8 still parses correctly.
The PR only adds filename sanitization to ComposerRepository warning/exception messages; zip archiving and timestamp handling are untouched, so extraction timestamps are unchanged.
Re-archiving is unaffected by the logging change in ComposerRepository; archive timestamps still derive from the source files as before.
The PR only changes CredentialCacheKey.IsPrefix case-sensitivity; System.Text.Json serialization/deserialization of a list with a nullable parent property is unaffected and works normally.
CredentialCache changes do not touch JSON serialization, so synchronous and asynchronous deserialization of the same payload remain equivalent and succeed.
INET containment (<<=) with ANY subquery is unrelated to the FETCH FIRST cursor fix; the query parses and returns true.
The cursor fix does not touch INET operators; >>= ANY over an INET array is standard syntax that should evaluate to true.
At base NO_PROXY=::1 is prefixed with a wildcard into all://*::1, which the URL-pattern parsing cannot interpret, so client construction raises an error.
After the fix is_ipv6_hostname routes ::1 to a valid all://[::1] bypass mount, so client construction succeeds and other hosts still proxy normally.
At base the GH-63108 validation breaks non-IGNORECASE flags: str.match with flags=re.DOTALL (or a compiled DOTALL pattern) raises a ValueError before matching.
The fix lets DOTALL flow through (pre-compiled for object dtype), so a.c with DOTALL matches a\nc and not ac, both via flags and via a compiled pattern.
At base freezing a chain containing a group followed by more tasks raises due to the recursive-result-parents bug, so building/submitting the chain with two groups fails.
The prepare_steps fix keeps prev_task/prev_res consistent after a group, so the chain freezes and each task in both groups keeps its own child result.

At base encountering a literal -- switches to trailing-values mode before the current positional's value_terminator is consulted, so the first positional captures everything including the flag-like token and the second gets nothing.
The fix gives the current positional's value_terminator precedence, so the -- ends the first positional and the flag-like token is collected by the second one without an error.
At base a late-arriving OSC11 response calls nvim_set_option_value which fires OptionSet, and the background change also fires ColorScheme, matching the test expectation.
The fix sets background via :noautocmd, so the late OSC11 response no longer triggers OptionSet (or ColorScheme), failing the test that expects both autocommands to fire.
The PR only reorders a compile-time @derive read in Ecto.Schema; runtime changeset casting plus validate_required still flags the missing field with a blank error.
The compile-time dependency change does not affect changeset validation behavior, so the omitted required field still makes the changeset invalid with a can't be blank error.
